othercustomfield.description: The bin that received stock lands in until digital verification completes. Inventory state is held in physical bins rather than NetSuite inventory statuses (technical design meeting, 8 September 2026). Mandatory in practice: the inbound Item Receipt cannot place stock and the inventory release cannot transfer it without this. KNOWN LIMITATION (T-32 / R-04): a bin does not remove stock from NetSuite availability, so unverified stock in this bin can still be committed to a sales order.
